entries.title: frameio

entries.title: make-announcement-video

entries.title: make-deck

entries.title: make-game

entries.title: make-image

entries.title: make-motion-graphics

entries.title: make-music

entries.title: make-product-demo
entries.summary: Make software demo videos, tutorials, app promos, launch videos or interactive product walkthroughs from actual UI, screenshots or recordings.

entries.title: make-social-loop
entries.summary: Create seamless graphic social loops, GIFs, stickers and animated graphic backgrounds.

entries.title: make-sound

entries.title: make-static-graphic

entries.title: mini-flows
entries.summary: Use when work chains two or more dependent media generations, puts a choice or review in the middle, or fans three or more variants into a later step: build it as a mini flow in the Flows panel.

entries.title: publish-game
entries.summary: Publish, update or unpublish static HTML/JavaScript games on voyager.site, or upload builds to itch.io.

entries.title: publish-video

entries.title: room-to-video
entries.summary: Reconstruct a captured room from overlapping photos or video for a Blender camera tour or guided restyle.

entries.title: sample-voice
entries.summary: Make a clean voice recording sound like a found sample, the spoken snippets sample-based music (lo-fi, downtempo) lays under a track: a phone call, in a cafe, an old radio, a cassette, a vinyl record. Use for "voice sample", "vocal sample", "spoken-word sample", "make it sound like a sample/vintage/lo-fi", "like it was recorded on the phone / in a cafe / on an old radio / on tape / on a record". Ultra and GigaMax plans only. Not new narration (voiceover), cleaning or levelling a recording (voiceover), or the music itself (make-sound).

entries.title: screen-capture
entries.summary: Record screen, window, camera and audio with editable cursor telemetry; style presenter camera tracks.

entries.title: video-styles
entries.summary: Style guides for named or stylized video looks.

entries.title: vmo
entries.summary: Use when rendering Remotion or HyperFrames projects with Voyager’s native vmo renderer.

entries.title: voiceover
entries.summary: Generate narration with Voyager voices, revise managed voice takes, or clean and repair speech recordings.

entries.title: voyager-setup
